children: Kering's third-quarter results are unlikely to be pivotal for the group's core Gucci brand, analysts at RBC Capital Markets Piral Dadhania and Richard Chamberlain write in a note. The French luxury giant has been trying to regain consumers' interest for Gucci's designs with creative director Demna. However, the Primavera collection hasn't been as appealing as expected, the analysts say. Still, Gucci should see some modest sequential improvement in the third quarter, while investors will focus on September trends to better understand the trajectory, they say. The analysts believe that current consensus estimates for 2027 are too high for both Kering and other luxury names. Kering's stock closed at 228.65 euros on Monday. (andrea.figueras@wsj.com)
